source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The test replaces synthesized pointer actions with programmatic HTML clicks and scrolls controls before activating them. It still waits for pane, progress, finish and notification state; the controller can start asynchronous picker/import work that the click call does not await. The main task directly checks UI state and exact success telemetry, while the large-ZIP task waits for any error notification rather than a specific error message. This describes this harness and these actual controls. It does not establish pointer/focus coverage, all imported settings, reliable timing or an intermittent cure, and no test ran here.
title: Direct import-test clicks retain explicit state waits
